item.title: Beg button not working on pelican crossing, 5th October
item.description:
The beg button on the pelican crossing on the corner of Swindon Road and Henrietta St, the opposite side of the road to the Holiday Inn Express, isn’t working. The WAIT light does not come on and the lights aren’t triggered to change. I couldn’t see the number on the post because there were too many stickers
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 29, Henrietta Street, Marle Hill, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
